art.name: automated-swarm-design
art.prompt: Premium editorial cover for AutoPSO automated particle swarm algorithm design. Wide 16:9 at least 1600 px wide. An ivory precision design board holds interchangeable graphite mechanical modules: a branching junction, a curved guide, a small adjustable gear and a divided swarm chamber. Above them a small constellation of red and charcoal candidate beads follows several delicate red threads into one assembled search mechanism. Emphasize reusable algorithm components assembled and evaluated into task-specific PSO designs. Warm ivory, charcoal and restrained brand red, tactile architectural miniature, elegant studio light, high-end editorial still-life. No text, logos, numbers, plots, screens, robots or claimed measurements.

art.name: semantics-to-parallel-code
art.prompt: Premium editorial cover for EvoCoCo semantics-preserving code tensorization. Wide 16:9 at least 1600 px wide. On a warm ivory tabletop, an irregular but carefully joined graphite chain of small geometric components enters an elegant red framed inspection gate; on the other side the same components are rearranged into a precise rectangular parallel lattice, with matching distinctive ivory connector shapes visible on both sides. Focus on changing execution structure while preserving meaningful connections, not literal before-after performance. Sophisticated industrial sculpture, tactile plaster and graphite metal, crisp shadows and restrained red highlights. No text, letters, logos, fake code, UI, robots, charts or numerical claims.

art.name: software-graphics-pipeline
art.prompt: Premium editorial cover for Genesis software graphics renderer construction. Wide 16:9 at least 1600 px wide. A small ivory geometric scene containing a sphere, stepped cube and folded triangle is seen through four offset translucent graphite-edged glass plates; each plate reveals a progressively assembled geometric facet, and a thin red structural line aligns all plates with a completed miniature scene on an ivory base. Focus on a coherent graphics pipeline assembled from compatible stages. Refined optical sculpture, beautiful natural studio light, warm ivory charcoal red, tactile high-end magazine still-life. No words, letters, logos, screenshots, comparison charts, benchmark numbers, robots or GPUs. Concept illustration, not rendered test output.
